paragraphs: R' Perira. He gave his teacher radishes after the sabbatical year, before Yom Kippur, which had been sown after Rosh Hashanah. They were a camel-load, and Rabbi marveled at this. At that time Rabbi permitted buying vegetables [immediately] after the sabbatical year; Jerusalem Talmud, Pe’ah 7:3:13 [Heilprin cites 7:4], and Bava Batra 9:4.
